import sys
src = sys.argv[1]
rows = []
with open(src) as fh:
    header = fh.readline().split()
    idx = {name: i for i, name in enumerate(header)}
    for line in fh:
        fields = line.split()
        if not fields:
            continue
        row = {
            "iid1": fields[idx["IID1"]],
            "iid2": fields[idx["IID2"]],
            "z0": float(fields[idx["Z0"]]),
            "z1": float(fields[idx["Z1"]]),
            "z2": float(fields[idx["Z2"]]),
            "pi": float(fields[idx["PI_HAT"]]),
            "ibs0": int(fields[idx["IBS0"]]),
            "ibs1": int(fields[idx["IBS1"]]),
            "ibs2": int(fields[idx["IBS2"]])
        }
        rows.append(row)
rows.sort(key=lambda r: (-r["pi"], r["iid1"], r["iid2"]))
selected = [r for r in rows if r["pi"] >= 0.375]
near = [r for r in rows if r["pi"] >= 0.300]
people = sorted({r["iid1"] for r in selected} | {r["iid2"] for r in selected})
with open("selected_pairs.tsv", "w") as out:
    out.write("IID1\tIID2\tZ0\tZ1\tZ2\tPI_HAT\tIBS0\tIBS1\tIBS2\n")
    for r in selected:
        out.write(f'{r["iid1"]}\t{r["iid2"]}\t{r["z0"]:.4f}\t{r["z1"]:.4f}\t{r["z2"]:.4f}\t{r["pi"]:.4f}\t{r["ibs0"]}\t{r["ibs1"]}\t{r["ibs2"]}\n')
with open("near_boundary.tsv", "w") as out:
    out.write("IID1\tIID2\tZ0\tZ1\tZ2\tPI_HAT\n")
    for r in near:
        out.write(f'{r["iid1"]}\t{r["iid2"]}\t{r["z0"]:.4f}\t{r["z1"]:.4f}\t{r["z2"]:.4f}\t{r["pi"]:.4f}\n')
with open("individuals.txt", "w") as out:
    out.write(",".join(people) if people else "None")
    out.write("\n")
below = [r for r in rows if r["pi"] < 0.375]
with open("diagnostics.txt", "w") as out:
    out.write(f"total_pairs={len(rows)}\n")
    out.write(f"selected_pairs={len(selected)}\n")
    out.write(f"selected_individuals={len(people)}\n")
    out.write(f"min_selected_pi_hat={min((r['pi'] for r in selected), default=float('nan')):.4f}\n")
    out.write(f"max_below_threshold_pi_hat={max((r['pi'] for r in below), default=float('nan')):.4f}\n")
    out.write(f"near_boundary_pairs_pi_hat_ge_0.300={len(near)}\n")
    out.write(f"threshold=0.375\n")
